mapper.select: SELECT A.ADDRESS_ID AS addressId, A.ADDRESS_ALIAS AS addressAlias, A.ZIPCODE AS zipcode, A.ADDRESS AS address, A.DETAILED_ADDRESS AS detailedAddress, A.DEFAULT_YN AS defaultYn, COALESCE(A.RECEIVER_NAME, U.USER_NAME) AS receiverName, COALESCE(A.RECEIVER_PHONE, U.USER_PHONE) AS receiverPhone FROM USER_ADDRESS A INNER JOIN `USER` U ON A.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE A.DEFAULT_YN WHEN 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, A.ADDRESS_ID DESC

SELECT c.cart_id AS cartId, c.quantity AS quantity, c.cart_type AS cartType, c.user_id AS userId, c.product_id AS productId, c.option_item_id AS optionItemId, c.rental_start AS rentalStart, c.rental_end AS rentalEnd, p.product_name AS productName, p.price AS price, p.deposit AS deposit, b.brand_name AS brandName, (p.price + COALESCE(poi.extra_price, 0)) AS unitPrice, COALESCE(poi.item_name, '기본 옵션') AS optionName, COALESCE(poi.extra_price, 0) AS optionPrice, ( SELECT img_url FROM product_img WHERE product_id = c.product_id AND is_main = 'Y' LIMIT 1 ) AS imgUrl FROM cart c INNER JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN brand b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id LEFT JOIN product_option_item poi ON c.option_item_id = poi.option_item_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.cart_type = #{cartType}
AND c.cart_id IN (${cartIds}) ORDER BY c.created_at DESC

INSERT INTO ORDERS ( ORDER_TYPE, ORDER_STATUS, TOTAL_PRICE, DISCOUNT_AMT, CREATED_AT, USER_ID, USER_COUPON_ID, GUEST_NAME, GUEST_PHONE, CART_IDS, USE_POINT ) VALUES ( #{cartType}, 'READY', #{amount}, #{discountAmt}, NOW(), #{userId},
#{userCouponId} NULL , #{guestName}, #{guestPhone}, #{cartIds}, #{usePoint} )

INSERT INTO PAYMENT ( ORDER_ID, AMOUNT, PAY_STATUS, PAY_METHOD, EASY_PAY_PROVIDER, PAID_AT, PAYMENT_KEY ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{amount}, 'PAID', #{payMethod}, #{easyPayProvider}, NOW(), #{paymentKey} )

INSERT INTO order_item ( ORDER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, OPTION_ITEM_ID, QUANTITY, UNIT_PRICE, START_DATE, END_DATE ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{productId}, #{optionItemId}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{rentalStart}, #{rentalEnd} )
mapper.select: SELECT O.ORDER_ID AS orderId, O.USER_ID AS userId, O.CART_IDS AS cartIds, O.USER_COUPON_ID AS userCouponId, O.ORDER_TYPE AS orderType, O.TOTAL_PRICE AS totalPrice, O.DISCOUNT_AMT AS discountAmt, O.USE_POINT AS usePoint, O.DISCOUNT_AMT AS discountAmt, O.GUEST_NAME AS guestName, O.GUEST_PHONE AS guestPhone, ( SELECT P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE OI.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID LIMIT 1 ) AS orderName, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDER_ITEM OI WHERE OI.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID ) AS itemCount FROM ORDERS O WHERE O.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_COUPON SET USED_YN = 'Y', USED_AT = NOW(), ORDER_ID = #{orderId}, STATUS = 'USED', UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE USER_COUPON_ID = #{userCouponId} AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'AVAILABLE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COUPON_USE_LOG ( USER_COUPON_ID, USER_ID, COUPON_ID, ORDER_ID, USED_AT, DISCOUNT_APPLIED_AMT ) SELECT #{userCouponId}, #{userId}, COUPON_ID, #{orderId}, NOW(), #{discountAmt} FROM USER_COUPON WHERE USER_COUPON_ID = #{userCouponId}
mapper.select: SELECT OI.ITEM_ID, OI.PRODUCT_ID, OI.OPTION_ITEM_ID, OI.QUANTITY, OI.START_DATE, OI.END_DATE, O.ORDER_TYPE FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN ORDERS O ON OI.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID WHERE OI.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PAYMENT_HISTORY ( PAY_TYPE, NEW_STATUS, CHANGED_AT, TARGET_PAY_ID ) VALUES ( #{payType}, 'PAID', NOW(), #{payId} )

INSERT INTO rentals ( ITEM_ID, USER_ID, START_DATE, RETURN_DATE, RENTAL_STATUS, CREATED_AT, GUEST_NAME, GUEST_PHONE ) VALUES ( #{itemId}, #{userId}, #{startDate}, #{returnDate}, 'PAID', NOW(), #{guestName}, #{guestPhone} )

INSERT INTO product_stock ( STOCK_DATE, TOTAL_QTY, RESERVED_QTY, AVAILABLE_QTY, OPTION_ITEM_ID, PRODUCT_ID ) SELECT DATE_ADD(#{startDate}, INTERVAL seq DAY), COALESCE(ref.TOTAL_QTY, #{defaultQty}), 0, COALESCE(ref.TOTAL_QTY, #{defaultQty}), #{optionItemId}, #{productId} FROM ( SELECT a.n + b.n * 10 + c.n * 100 AS seq FROM (SELECT 0 n UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9) a CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 n UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9) b CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 n UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3) c ) nums LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TOTAL_QTY FROM product_stock WHERE OPTION_ITEM_ID = #{optionItemId} ORDER BY STOCK_DATE DESC LIMIT 1 ) ref ON 1=1 WHERE DATE_ADD(#{startDate}, INTERVAL seq DAY) < #{endDate} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE STOCK_DATE = STOCK_DATE
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PAYMENT WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND PAY_STATUS = 'PAID'
